parameters.name: CopyType
parameters.description: The type of the object that is copied. Only the INSTANCE type is supported.

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the source object. Only instance IDs are supported.

parameters.name: TargetId
parameters.description: The ID of the target object. Only instance IDs are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns copy-gtm-config --lang en --source-id gtm-cn-0pp1j84v60d --target-id gtm-cn-v0h1gaujg06 --copy-type INSTANCE --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns CopyGtmConfig --region cn-hangzhou --SourceId 'gtm-cn-0pp1j84v60d' --Lang en --CopyType INSTANCE --TargetId 'gtm-cn-v0h1gaujg06'
